newsitem.title: UK: Turkey tenders for up to 110,000 tonnes fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Turkey tenders for up to 110,000 tonnes fuel oil.

text.p: Turkey's state utility Tupras has issued two tenders to buy up to 110,000 tonnes of high and low sulphur cracked fuel oil for delivery around mid-November, traders said on Monday.

Tupras tendered for 25,000-50,000 tonnes of high sulphur cracked fuel oil for delivery to Izmit and Aliaga between November 11 and 15, and for 55,000-60,000 tonnes of low sulphur cracked fuel oil for delivery between November 20 and 25.
The low sulphur fuel oil was for delivery into Aliaga and Izmit, or alternatively into Tutunciftlik and Izmit.
Traders said Tupras normally exports high sulphur fuel oil and it was unusual for them to buy product.
One refinery-based trader in London said the tender may reflect a decision to have cut refining runs.

Tupras officials were not available for comment, but last week private refiner Atas, with around 14 percent of domestic market share, brought production to a standstill because of problems with the government's pricing policy for refined products.
